---
name: provenance-check
description: Check Ventura Interview questions frameworks and preparation references for accurate attribution and license boundaries. Use when adapting external interview material or competency frameworks. Do not use when the change is original repository guidance with no external source dependency.

# Provenance check

- Identify external question banks frameworks courses or articles influencing the change.
- Distinguish common interview concepts from copied wording or proprietary question sets.
- Read `PROVENANCE.md` when present and keep it aligned.
- Preserve required attribution and license terms for derived material.
- Prefer original questions and explanations when copying is unnecessary.
- Remove unsupported employer affiliation or certification implications.
